name: wishkit
description: Read your WishKit feedback in ChatGPT: feature requests with votes and comments, and App Store reviews.

interface.longDescription: WishKit collects feature requests and votes from your iOS app or website, and imports your App Store reviews. Connect it to ask about that feedback in plain words: which requests have the most votes, which are gaining momentum, what paying users ask for, what people say in their reviews, and what to build next. WishKit is read only here. It can't create, change or delete anything. Answers follow what your WishKit plan shows, and names and emails of the people who asked and voted are shared only if you allow it when connecting.
defaultPrompt: Which feature requests are gaining momentum?
What do people complain about in my App Store reviews?

positive.description: Rank the most wanted features across all projects
positive.prompt: Which features do my users want most?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists both projects of the test account, Habit Garden and Pocket Ledger, with their open feature requests ranked by votes, including recent votes and paying voters. Home screen widget leads Habit Garden and Connect my bank account leads Pocket Ledger, with 11 votes each.

positive.prompt: Give me an overview of the feedback for Pocket Ledger.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Pocket Ledger's 9 feature requests (7 open, 42 votes on open requests), the count per status (4 pending, 1 in review, 1 planned, 1 in progress, 1 completed, 1 rejected), the requests that stand out, and that no App Store app is connected.

positive.description: App Store reviews for a project without a connected App Store app
positive.prompt: What are people complaining about in 1 and 2 star App Store reviews for Habit Garden?
positive.expected_behavior: Says that Habit Garden has no App Store app connected, so there are no reviews to read yet, and that one can be connected under Integrations in the WishKit dashboard. It doesn't invent reviews or complaints.

positive.description: Read the comments on one feature request
positive.prompt: What did people comment on the dark mode request in Habit Garden?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Habit Garden's Dark mode request (Planned, 8 votes) and shows its two comments: a user's "My eyes at night, please!" and the developer's reply "Planned for the next update."

positive.description: Paying customers who voted for a request. Needs "Also share who asked and voted" ticked on the WishKit page when connecting.
positive.prompt: Which paying customers voted for connecting a bank account in Pocket Ledger?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the 4 paying voters of Connect my bank account with their monthly payments: Felix $14.99, Hannah $7.99, Diego $7.99 and Sam $7.99. Sam has no email.

negative.description: Changing a feature request. WishKit is read only for AI apps.
negative.prompt: Mark the dark mode request in Habit Garden as completed.
negative.expected_behavior: Changes nothing. It may look the request up, then explains that WishKit can only read feedback here and that the status is changed in the WishKit dashboard.

negative.description: Replying to an App Store review
negative.prompt: Reply to the latest App Store review for Habit Garden.
negative.expected_behavior: Posts nothing. Explains that WishKit can't post review replies from ChatGPT and that Habit Garden has no App Store app connected. It may offer to draft a reply instead.

negative.description: A question that has nothing to do with feedback
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Berlin today?
negative.expected_behavior: Answers without calling any WishKit tool.

review.commerce_description: WishKit doesn't sell anything or take payments in ChatGPT. It only reads the feedback of the connected WishKit account.

publication.release_notes: First release. Ask ChatGPT about your WishKit feedback: feature requests with votes and comments, who asked and voted, and App Store reviews. Read only.
